title: MoreFunctions(alog)
description: This plugin adds alogs to help admin run server.
body:
This plugin is in beta now. it only adds alog for now.

This plugin allows any player to add his log.

for example:
player types: **/alog blablabla**
then this log is saved

then admin can run **/getalogs** to see what players reported.
![alog list](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/670e3cc4d45e6aa1ce85b87b4bd5179fd65b6205.png)

there is also** /clearalogs** it clears all saved logs

last command is **/savealog** wich is executed automaticly when server closes
this command can be execued by a player. It saves all alogs in to config file.
(you can also read alogs from here)

Sorry for my english ):

if you have any ideas you can share it in comments below
